id: title:Gilbert09:recognize mariadb s host not allowed wording as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Connects to warehouse ingestion reliability: the warehouse connector previously failed to recognize MariaDB's variant of error 1130, potentially causing unnecessary retries or misclassification of connection failures. This change broadens the matching key to the stable phrase, improving compatibility across MySQL and MariaDB.
review.reason: Replaces a MySQL-specific error message key with a broader, stable phrase and adds MariaDB-specific test case. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and compatibility improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime behavior and frequency of MariaDB connection failures are not independently verified; the benefit relies on the supplied observation rather than demonstrated production impact.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
